note: Controlled benchmark of the engine at commit 4850f56 (v0.10.0 plus: the icon sanitiser fix so rect-based Lucide icons draw, brand-tinted surfaces reverted to opt-in, style keywords for outdoor, catering, tree and forms briefs, and the earlier two-tone colour, gate and layout fixes). Haiku 5.5 without vs with the MCP, identical SPEC.md, same 60-call budget, four never-seen domains (copperline plumbers, pagebound bookshop, saffron restaurant, tempo time-tracking software), engine frozen for the run. RESULT: engine 3/8 (baseline 5/8), judged more template-like in 5/8 (it was 8/8 in v0.9.0 and v0.10.0): the best generator result since the hybrid experiment, but still a loss. The three engine wins were tempo r1 and r2 (a software brief: editorial-paper, a Week 44 timesheet mockup hero, italic-accent serif headline) and copperline r2 (custom feature illustrations, a boiler hero). Typography is nearly tied (7.50 vs 7.38) and colour 7.50 vs 7.00. CAUTION: this is one run of 8 judgements over 4 briefs, the wins cluster on two briefs, and several things changed at once (icon fix, tint revert, matcher, new briefs), so the improvement cannot be attributed to any one change; the previous two runs went 0/8. The agents again patched style, so the new styles were largely not exercised. The spec forbids external images for both arms, so the photo, logo-prompt and placeholder tools were not exercised. COST: engine arm tokens 104k-118k vs baseline 96k-130k, tool calls 18-24 vs 11-21, time 186-274 s vs 181-310 s: roughly comparable this run. DEFECTS named by agents (to fix): the brief patch did not take the testimonials, pricing and FAQ section title keys, so those headings stay generic; one agent's own report miscounted its feature cards (the page had 5, the report said 4). CONFOUNDS: one MCP agent left a preview-screenshots folder inside its deliverable (the evaluator ignores it); one baseline agent edited its HTML after its last browser check; several agents deleted their own scratch files. NOT deployed to Vercel (no VERCEL_TOKEN in this environment).
